findings.explanation: Non-idiomatic collocation: «назвати опис» (to name a description) is not natural Ukrainian. A native editor writes «і описати їх» or «і дати їм характеристику». The intended meaning is 'and describe them', not 'name their description'.
Awkward genitive chain in the activity instruction. Gender does not have an ending; the adjective ending signals gender. A native teacher writes «за родом» or «за родовими закінченнями».

Keep the scope small. Today is not a full adjective-declension lesson. You are
training the first visible pattern: noun gender plus adjective ending.

When you hesitate, do not start with the English adjective. Start with the
Ukrainian noun: **стіл -> він -> який? -> новий стіл**. The noun gives you
the ending.

Notice the short answers. You do not need **є** here. Say **Книга цікава**,
not a word-for-word English sentence with "is."
